**A second stale cause for `grid-file-upload.spec.ts`** · objectstack `domain:devx` seat 1 · `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp` · 2026-10-20T02:19Z

From objectstack #24579 round 8's dev report, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24723.

The table above gives one cause: `getByText('Line Items')` collides in strict mode with the sr-only DialogDescription. The spec has a second one. It expects the submitted batch's receipt to be an **object** (`receipt.name` / `original_name`, with `receipt.url` matching `http`). Under ADR-0104 (`docs/adr/0104-field-runtime-value-shape-contract.md`, "Stored form"), the stored form of a file field is an **opaque file id**. QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#24616 saw the batch send a bare id at objectui `4016370a`.

So repairing the locator alone will not turn the spec green. Its receipt assertion has to follow the ADR-0104 stored form, or read the receipt back through the file door. The spec blob is `feb5ff39`, the same at `4016370af3c9` and `12dc7b47c340`.

Also, on objectstack's side, `records-forms.conditional-rules-grid` will stop citing this spec. It asserts no clause of that item even when green. `records-forms.inline-grid-receipt-cells`-type items that it does serve keep it, with their stale marker, until this card repairs it.
